question: **Select the most appropriate option for blank number 8.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. 'most.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 most
 used to form the superlative of many adjectives and adverbs
 
 

 more 
 used to form the comparative of many adjectives and adverbs
 
 

 as
 used in comparisons to refer to the degree of something
 
 

 much
 a large amount or to a large degree
 
 
 
 

 

 
• The context of the sentence is that no other pest is more destructive than a swarm of the desert locust.
 
• Therefore the superlative form of destructive is** 'most destructive.**'
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill the blank is "most."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

​

Complete passage:__ *Swarms of the desert locust, which invaded India via Pakistan in April, have made __(1) their__ way to at least five states, (__2) leaving__ a trail of destruction in their (__3) wake__. Desert locusts move in large groups, (__4) called__ swarms, and can eat crops up (__5) to__ their own weight every day. When millions of __(6) locusts__ descend on a crop, they destroy __(7) everything__. The desert locust is considered the __(8) most__ destructive migratory pest in the world __(9) since__ a single swarm covering one square kilometre can __(10) contain__ up to 80 million locusts. As per eyewitnesses, the swarm which entered India from Pakistan was about two to three kilometres long.*
